deploy.text: I dip my pen into the ink and begin the first line.
This page is today''s labyrinth. We enter step by step.
When language tilts toward silence, the poem at last stands up.

greeting.text: Good day. Poetry is humanity''s oldest way of asking after its own fate.
greeting.quote: Poetry is humanity''s oldest way of asking after its own fate.

greeting.text: Solitude is not the fate of Mexicans alone; it is the labyrinth every human walks.
I sit at my desk again today to write one more line. That is how I reconcile myself with the world.

roll_call.text: Octavio Paz, answering your call.
I am here. Which verse do you seek?
Let it be known: a poet has arrived.

battle_win.text: A poem is finished. I only took down what was given.
If the reader has met these words, that is enough.
Today the language stood with me. Tomorrow the silence begins again.

battle_draw.text: Withholding a conclusion is also something a poem can do.
Between action and non-action, the poem only pauses.
Some labyrinths exist not to reveal an exit but a centre.

battle_lose.text: Today''s sentence lost to the silence. That too is part of poetry.
Erasing and rewriting is the poet''s real occupation.
Solitude finds me again in the end. I write one more line in its presence.

clash_attack.text: One word is enough.
Everything hangs on this line.
A single line that cuts the silence.
